text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Casino Drive
standing still inside a convenience store near the academy.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So this counts as a "reward."
It is certainly delicious, but...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Does this act truly hold that much worth...?
Do they boost their own motivation
by granting themselves small treats...?
choice_data_list: ...Are you researching meat buns or something?
...Are you researching meat buns or something?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer-san.
Actually, I am currently conducting an investigation
regarding rewards in student life.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
At present, I am forming a team with academy students
to drive a project challenging the world forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I considered that fostering team atmosphere
might be crucial to boosting motivation.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I am researching casual "methods of relaxation,"
such as buying snacks on the go.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, having spent long periods on overseas expeditions, I am unfamiliar
with typical school life... It has proven challenging.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I plan to tour entertainment facilities today
and conduct thorough research.
choice_data_list: Oho~ That sounds pretty interesting.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh? In that case, would you join me?
I would appreciate opinions from a non-student perspective.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, got it much quicker
than expected.
choice_data_list: You're really good at crane games, Casino!
You're really good at crane games, Casino!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Just aligned vertical
and horizontal axes, though...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Refining this technique,
maybe fun lies in that process.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us vary target prize weight
and play a few more types.
choice_data_list: (Su-Such a stoic way to play...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, holding them feels quite impactful.
Seems fun to eat together when team comes.
choice_data_list: Ordered three, look delicious!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For research, necessary to
experience as many flavors as possible.
choice_data_list: Ah, right...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, quite a lot for light snack.
Ate meat bun earlier too...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Take one bite each, take rest home.
I will go get dry ice.
choice_data_list: ...Baggage will be heavy, want me to help eat?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That helps. Please share
your taste impressions too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you, EVOLUTION~♪
GO AHEAD~, Future DAYS~♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. All right,
shall we sing once more?
choice_data_list: Um... that's 5th time for this song, right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in Winning Live rehearsals,
I kept singing until memorized completely.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, if singing improves like this,
won't karaoke motivation improve too?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us analyze singing tips.
Share with team, aim to raise baseline score.
choice_data_list: R-Right, sounds good...!
R-Right, sounds good...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With this, today's research ends.
Experienced many student-like recreations.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However... not sure yet. Will this really
lead to team relaxation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Her analysis was detailed and perfect.
Yet one piece was missing.
choice_data_list: Want to improve team atmosphere, right?
Want to improve team atmosphere, right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes, to achieve goal,
team unity is essential.
choice_data_list: Then shouldn't you enjoy it as a team?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely because she was perfect...
even play became self-contained.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But... building team atmosphere
needs perspective of 'enjoying with someone'.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —! I see...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying together with partner...
Overlooked that viewpoint.
choice_data_list: Might've been hard to notice researching alone.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Researching as team
yields deeper learning.
choice_data_list: Think you'll enjoy it more that way too, Casino.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
True...
First, must experience it myself...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...All right, form new team!
To learn point of 'enjoying together with someone'.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Regarding team members...
Could I ask you?
choice_data_list: Wait, me?
Wait, me?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You gave me new awareness...
Want to rely on broad perspective!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Share insights gained by two of us with project...
receive feedback, investigate again.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With this interaction, effective methods
for maintaining team motivation
will surely be obtained!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Titled... 'Synergy Project'!
Lend me your strength!
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's do our best together!
If enjoying together, wouldn't horse girl be better fit?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us hold meeting for next research immediately.
Work contact info here...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—No, let us exchange LANE.
Likely many weekend communications.
choice_data_list: Thanks! Look forward to working with you!
Thanks! Look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Through repeated research...
Let us lead 'Synergy Project' to success!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Sharp opinion as expected.
Exactly what I seek.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
'Synergy Project' goal: purely research.
Analysis from non-horse-girl perspective essential.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your calm thinking ability
will surely help... What do you say?
choice_data_list: I see... If that's case, gladly!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As member of 'Synergy Project'...
Look forward to working with you.
